title: Made a survivors-like game entirely in Godot
author: LightconeGames
selftext:
This is my first completed game project made almost entirely with AI (I did do quite a few small hobby ones before on my own). It's made pretty much entirely with Claude, and by that I mean no image or music generation model. Sprites were made by Claude using my own custom made MCP for pixel art, and music and sounds were composed using ChucK. I did contribute writing and directed fairly closely all the design ideas, the plans for the levels, enemies, bosses and skills.

The core gameplay loop is survivors-like meets One Finger Death Punch; enemies on both sides in a 1D side-scrolling fighting stage, and skills are combos that you need to trigger intentionally (but still have cooldowns).
